billing/payments/retry.py	def retry_with_backoff(call, attempts=5):\n    """Retry a failed call with exponential backoff."""\n    for attempt in range(attempts):\n        try:\n            return call()\n        except PaymentError as error:\n            sleep(2 ** attempt)\n    raise error
billing/payments/errors.py	class PaymentError(Exception):\n    """Raised when a payment fails: the card was declined or the gateway timed out."""\n    pass
